responsibility: Implements inference of side-effect ranges that arise from executing statements rather than from their explicit results. It detects facts such as nonnull pointers implied by dereferences or function attributes and assumption-derived parameter ranges, summarizes them per statement in gimple_infer_range, and manages per-basic-block exit-range summaries in infer_range_manager so ranger queries can intersect these inferred facts with ordinary SSA ranges.
same_name_distinction: Implements inference collection and storage, including statement scans for nonnull/nonzero facts, ASSUME-derived ranges, and per-block exit summaries managed by infer_range_manager. Unlike gcc/gimple-range-infer.h, it contains the concrete scanning, caching, and immediate-use registration code rather than just the inference API declarations.
